reason: A schema-only range probe showed that San Emidio level-0 is packaged in large uncompressed TAR objects containing the actual complete native waveform files. Treating a TAR container as one seismic file makes deterministic span size depend on archive packaging rather than the declared numeric seismic payload. Before any frozen headline compression result, selection is therefore refined to complete internal native waveform members only. No waveform values, statistics, or compression outputs are used for this refinement.

land_san_emidio_2021.test_policy: 3x >=10GB deterministic spans over complete native level-0 .AU4/.DLD waveform members inside the public TAR archives
